name: itu_bs2051_system_h
character: ITU-R BS.2051 System H: the eight-loudspeaker 7.1 ring at listener ear level, azimuths clockwise from front centre.
sources: ITU-R BS.2051-3: System H loudspeaker positions (starting values: azimuths -30/30/0/135/90 degrees, elevation 0)
ITU-R BS.1770-4: +1.5 dB weighting for the surround channels in the loudness measurement
ITU-R BS.775-3 Annex: fold-down coefficients 1.0 for front L/R, 0.7071 for centre and each surround; LFE is left out of the two-channel fold

The shared-reverb spread (front 0 dB, surround -6 dB, height -12 dB, anything within 30 degrees of front centre counted as front) is a starting value for this engine's level balance, not a measured acoustic value
The low-frequency release fade (10 ms) and the guard depth (4 cascaded Linkwitz-Riley sections at the stopband) are starting values for this engine's filters, not measured acoustic values
